WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: When a winning combination occurs, all regular paying symbols of the type that were part of the winning combination are removed from the grid, and new ones drop down to fill the empty spaces.

scatters.name: HOT 100 BONUS - LAST ASCENSION
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 100 free spins by landing 3 Hot 100 symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game keeps the mechanics of the THUNDER REIGN bonus, with an increased chance of forming CoinWays™.

 FS symbols cannot land in this bonus game

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 Hot 100 symbols act as scatter symbols and can only land during the base game. FS symbols and Hot 100 symbols cannot be on the grid at the same time.

specials.name: SUPER CASCADES
specials.behavior: When a winning combination occurs, all regular paying symbols of the type that were part of the winning combination are removed from the grid, and new ones drop down to fill the empty spaces.

specials.name: COINWAYS™
specials.behavior:
When Bronze, Silver or Gold Coin symbols land in a formation that is equivalent to one of the predetermined Ways to win, CoinWays™ are formed. CoinWays™ must start at the leftmost reel and include Coin symbols on at least 3 adjacent reels. If there are Coins on reels 1, 2, 3 and 5, the CoinWays™ will only include the Coin values of the first 3 reels. CoinWays™ are activated after regular wins have been handled.

 Bronze Coins can have the following values: 1x 
 Silver Coins can have the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x 
 Gold Coins can have the following values: 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x 

 When CoinWays™ activate, the Coin symbols add their values to the Coin Bar value for the reel they land on. Each reel’s Coin value will be displayed in the Coin Bar located outside of the grid. If there are multiple Coins on a reel, the Coin values are added together to determine the total Coin value of the reel.

 Once the Coin symbol values have been added to the Coin Bar, the values in the Coin Bar will be multiplied from left to right. For example, if values in the Coin Bar are 2, 3, 2, 7, 3, the final CoinWays™ value will be 2x3x2x7x3=252x. The CoinWays™ value will be awarded as a cash prize that is multiplied by your bet to determine the final win. The Coin Bar will reset before the next spin.

 Coin symbols can only land in the THUNDER REIGN, WRATH OF OLYMPUS and LAST ASCENSION bonuses.

 Coin symbols can also land in SACRED FEATURESPINS™.

modes.name: BONUS GAME - THUNDER REIGN
modes.trigger: landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the base game’s mechanics with a chance of landing Bronze, Silver and Gold Coin symbols and form CoinWays™.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins 
 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins

modes.name: BONUS GAME - WRATH OF OLYMPUS
modes.trigger: landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game keeps the mechanics of the THUNDER REIGN bonus with at least 1 Coin symbol guaranteed to land on every spin.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins 
 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins

evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
ABOUT THE GAME

 The king of gods returns, as thunder echoes across the heavens and a new trial rises before him—one that may prove to be his greatest yet.

 For ages untold, legends have spoken of Zeus’ mighty battles against Titans and Giants, clashes that shook the very foundations of the cosmos. Now, a threat stirs, and the riches of his divine realm stand in peril. With lightning in hand and power unrivaled, Zeus must once again rise to defend what is his.

 Supreme Zeus is a 5-reel, 4-row game with Ways and a max win of {maximumWinMultiplier} times your bet available in the THUNDER REIGN
